definition: a white powder added to food to give it taste
exampleSentence: This soup needs a little more salt.
exampleTranslation: Món súp này cần thêm một chút muối.

definition: a small container for salt with holes in the top
exampleSentence: The salt shaker is on the table.
exampleTranslation: Lọ muối ở trên bàn.

definition: a sweet white or brown substance added to food and drinks
exampleSentence: I take one spoon of sugar in my tea.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho một thìa đường vào trà.

definition: a sweet sticky food made by bees
exampleSentence: I put honey on my bread.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phết mật ong lên bánh mì.

definition: a substance used instead of sugar to make food or drink sweeter
exampleSentence: I use a sweetener in my coffee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng chất tạo ngọt trong cà phê.

definition: a thick sweet liquid poured on or mixed into food
exampleSentence: We had pancakes with maple syrup.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn bánh kếp với xi-rô cây phong.

definition: a smooth liquid from plants, used for cooking
exampleSentence: Heat the oil in a pan.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đun nóng dầu trong chảo.

definition: oil from plants, used for frying and cooking food
exampleSentence: We need to buy some cooking oil.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta cần mua ít dầu ăn.

definition: a pale oil made from olives, used in cooking
exampleSentence: I make my salad with olive oil.
exampleTranslation: Tôi làm món salad với dầu ô liu.

definition: a sour liquid used to give food a sharp taste
exampleSentence: Add a little vinegar to the salad.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thêm một chút giấm vào món salad.

definition: a dark salty liquid made from soya beans
exampleSentence: Dip the spring roll in soy sauce.
exampleTranslation: Hãy chấm chả giò vào nước tương.

definition: a thick red sauce made from tomatoes
exampleSentence: Do you want ketchup with your fries?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn ăn khoai tây chiên với tương cà không?

definition: a thick white sauce made from eggs and oil
exampleSentence: I put mayonnaise in my sandwich.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho sốt mayonnaise vào bánh sandwich.

definition: a yellow sauce with a strong taste, eaten with meat
exampleSentence: My friend likes mustard on a hot dog.
exampleTranslation: Bạn tôi thích ăn xúc xích với mù tạt.

definition: a mixture of oil and vinegar put on a salad
translation: nước sốt trộn salad, nước xốt salad
exampleSentence: What dressing would you like on your salad?
exampleTranslation: Bạn muốn dùng nước sốt nào cho món salad?

definition: a liquid made by boiling meat or vegetables, used in soups
exampleSentence: Add the chicken stock to the pot.
exampleTranslation: Cho nước dùng gà vào nồi.

definition: vegetables kept in vinegar or salty water
exampleSentence: I like pickles in my sandwich.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích có dưa chua trong bánh sandwich.

definition: a powder made from wheat, used for making bread and cakes
exampleSentence: Mix the flour with two eggs.
exampleTranslation: Trộn bột mì với hai quả trứng.

definition: a fine white flour made from corn, used to thicken sauces
exampleSentence: Add a spoon of cornflour to thicken the sauce.
exampleTranslation: Cho một thìa bột bắp vào để nước sốt đặc lại.

definition: a substance used to make bread rise
exampleSentence: Bread needs yeast to rise.
exampleTranslation: Bánh mì cần men để nở phồng.

definition: a powder used to make cakes lighter
exampleSentence: Add a teaspoon of baking powder.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thêm một thìa cà phê bột nở.

definition: very small pieces of bread used in cooking
translation: vụn bánh mì, bột chiên xù
exampleSentence: Cover the fish in breadcrumbs.
exampleTranslation: Phủ vụn bánh mì lên miếng cá.

definition: a sweet mixture of sugar and liquid used to cover cakes
translation: lớp kem phủ bánh, kem đường
exampleSentence: The cake has pink icing.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc bánh có lớp kem phủ màu hồng.

definition: a powder or seed from a plant, used to give food a special taste
exampleSentence: Pepper and cinnamon are common spices.
exampleTranslation: Hạt tiêu và quế là những loại gia vị phổ biến.

definition: salt, pepper or spices added to food for taste
exampleSentence: Taste the soup and add more seasoning.
exampleTranslation: Hãy nếm món súp và nêm thêm gia vị.

definition: one separate part of a garlic bulb
exampleSentence: Add two cloves of garlic.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cho thêm hai tép tỏi.

definition: a mixture of spices used to make curry
exampleSentence: Add a spoon of curry powder.
exampleTranslation: Cho thêm một thìa bột cà ri.

definition: a sweet brown spice used in cakes and sweet foods
exampleSentence: I like cinnamon in my coffee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích cho quế vào cà phê.

definition: a substance used to give ice cream and cakes a sweet taste
exampleSentence: Do you have vanilla ice cream?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có kem vani không?

definition: a soft thick mixture that is easy to spread
exampleSentence: Mix the spices into a smooth paste.
exampleTranslation: Trộn các loại gia vị thành một hỗn hợp nhuyễn.

definition: a sweet food made from fruit and sugar, put on bread
exampleSentence: I like strawberry jam on toast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích mứt dâu trên bánh mì nướng.

definition: a sweet brown food made from cocoa
exampleSentence: I love dark chocolate.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất thích sô-cô-la đen.

definition: a brown powder used to make chocolate and hot drinks
exampleSentence: Mix the cocoa with hot milk.
exampleTranslation: Hòa bột ca cao với sữa nóng.

definition: a dry fruit with a hard shell that grows on a tree
exampleSentence: Some people are allergic to nuts.
exampleTranslation: Một số người bị dị ứng với các loại hạt.

definition: a small pale brown nut that grows under the ground
exampleSentence: I bought a bag of roasted peanuts.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua một túi đậu phộng rang.

definition: a flat pale nut with a sweet taste
exampleSentence: I put chopped almonds on the cake.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rắc hạnh nhân cắt nhỏ lên bánh.

definition: a brown nut shaped like a small brain
translation: quả óc chó, hạt óc chó
exampleSentence: This cake is made with walnuts.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc bánh này được làm từ quả óc chó.

definition: a small curved nut with a sweet taste
exampleSentence: I like cashews more than peanuts.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích hạt điều hơn đậu phộng.

definition: a plant whose small seeds are used in cooking
exampleSentence: Sprinkle sesame seeds on the rice.
exampleTranslation: Rắc hạt mè lên cơm.

definition: a long thin piece of food made from flour, cooked in soup
exampleSentence: I had a bowl of noodles for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn một tô mì cho bữa trưa.

definition: a small amount of salt or pepper held between finger and thumb
exampleSentence: Add a pinch of salt.
exampleTranslation: Thêm một nhúm muối.

definition: the particular taste of a food or drink
exampleSentence: Which flavour of ice cream do you want?
exampleTranslation: Bạn muốn kem vị nào?

definition: the feeling a food or drink gives in your mouth
exampleSentence: I like the taste of ginger.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích vị của gừng.

definition: tasting of or containing salt
exampleSentence: The soup is too salty.
exampleTranslation: Món súp này mặn quá.

definition: having a strong hot taste from spices
exampleSentence: I cannot eat spicy food.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không ăn được đồ cay.

definition: having very little taste
exampleSentence: The soup is a bit bland.
exampleTranslation: Món súp hơi nhạt.

definition: having a good taste
exampleSentence: This fish is really tasty.
exampleTranslation: Món cá này thật sự rất ngon.

definition: very good to taste or smell
exampleSentence: The cake smells delicious.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc bánh này có mùi thơm ngon.

definition: to have a particular flavour
exampleSentence: This soup tastes too sweet.
exampleTranslation: Món súp này có vị quá ngọt.

definition: to put something together with something else
exampleSentence: Add some water to the rice.
exampleTranslation: Cho thêm một ít nước vào cơm.

definition: to scatter small pieces or drops over something
exampleSentence: Sprinkle some cheese on the pasta.
exampleTranslation: Rắc một ít phô mai lên mì Ý.

definition: to add salt, pepper or spices to food
exampleSentence: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
exampleTranslation: Nêm gà với muối và tiêu.

definition: to leave meat or fish in a sauce before cooking
exampleSentence: Marinate the fish for one hour.
exampleTranslation: Ướp cá trong một tiếng.
